sections.heading: Product-planning mistake
sections.content: The mistake was failing to identify all the trust and harm risks during the initial product planning. Open to Work is a useful signal that helps people support job seekers, but it can also expose job seekers—whom Cohen said may be more vulnerable to scams—to bad actors. When LinkedIn ran the feature’s spec through its trust agent, the agent found risks the team had addressed initially as well as holes they only caught later.
